title: Replicating Human Motivated Reasoning Studies with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Replicating four human studies on motivated reasoning by prompting LLMs with different motivation inductions (accuracy-driven vs. directional/predetermined goals) and measuring their policy support and argument strength assessments compared to human baselines.

Evaluating LLM responses to political issues (e.g., fracking, taxes, the DREAM Act) when presented with partisan cues, elite polarization, and party endorsements to determine if they exhibit partisan alignment.
